test_title: PYST 27: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 17 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of :: ?

# : DFJ :: LNR : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

Given:

# : DFJ :: LNR : %

**Option 1) # = ACG , % = OQU**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39255266f5f9dd670174f24d26c7986a8d7015fa74e355b98f48224ae48b90c6.png] 

 

**For LNR to % (OQU)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/721b9f189a92a976b020ccea71844f3fdd5f3ac79be81b57c4f3486196565e26.png] 

 

Since the pattern for ACG to DFJ (+3, +3, +3) is the same as the pattern for LNR to OQU (+3, +3, +3), Option 1 is correct.

**Option 2) # = ACG , % = MQU**

**For # (ACG) to DFJ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6dae2972c0e7bfb74752f2f105d2a37a6add83d3212ae40d549530aaa4838acc.png] 

 

**For LNR to % (MQU)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a6350389662c356795f5f658b9dff173d3fc2c6728f4a0869a7f8586972cc4f.png] 

Option 2 is incorrect.

**Option 3) # = BCG , % = OQU**

**For # (BCG) to DFJ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f793411faf61f60f36b27b0caf61d805e3175b1417d6b637413974579977695.png] 

 

**For LNR to % (OQU)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23fb13aac4e80f39ec688a7f4fe11004131dbd7b08c4d0544952b2b3831e535c.png] 

 

Option 3 is incorrect.

**Option 4) # = ACG , % = OQP**

**For # (ACG) to DFJ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f55e6d06cb17441351e715afa5ffbc6298ef0ee2033664976a083bd806aec97f.png] 

The pattern derived from ACG to DFJ is: (+3, +3, +3).

**For LNR to % (OQP)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7e3a17af3dbbd65d60e6cbe26115abe39608c543222bcc937abce3c9c2c2dfe.png] 

 

Option 4 is incorrect.

Thus, the analogy holds true only for **Option 1.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
